# Third-party components

The application links devkitPro/libctru, Citro2D/Citro3D and LZ4 from the SDK.
Their source and license notices remain with those projects. The shared media
runtime retains PL_MPEG's complete MIT notice in `engine/source/engine/codecs/pl_mpeg.h`.
Conversion setup downloads verified Python packages and FFmpeg when missing;
those tools retain their upstream licenses and are not part of the application.
